services.subtitle: Comprehensive support for the Kenyan diaspora
services.landVerificationDesc: Verify land titles, conduct official searches, and inspect properties before you invest.

services.vehicleInspectionDesc: Thorough inspections and history checks before you buy a vehicle for family back home.
services.relocationSupportDesc: End-to-end relocation assistance — from shipping to settling in.
services.familySupportDesc: Regular check-ins on elderly parents, school visits, and emergency coordination.
services.fraudPreventionDesc: Background checks, due diligence, and verification of business partners and agents.
services.documentFacilitationDesc: Help with KRA PIN, passport renewals, certificates, and government documents.
services.consultationDesc: Expert advice on investments, property, business setup, and legal matters.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple, transparent process from request to completion
howItWorks.step1Desc: Tell us what you need — land verification, inspection, or family support. Provide details and we'll get back to you promptly.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our local team handles everything on the ground. You get real-time updates with photos, videos, and reports.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get a detailed report with findings, recommendations, and next steps. All accessible from your dashboard.
